implementation.default: OFF; no source consumption, scorer call, file access or physics dispatch
implementation.source: In-memory digest-protected admitted cooperative all8/per_seed_v1 records from the requested arm's own bank, bound to authoritative first-seed verification provenance
implementation.parameters: Explicit registered perturbation settings; onset/hold/depth inherit variety windows; full plan duration retained
implementation.partners: At most one non-ego partner replaced by a t-1 visible same-lane CAV; 2..4 distinct CAV members including ego
implementation.traffic_context: Whitelisted local sensing/V2V observations retain both CAVs and HDVs; all rows timestamp-validated; separate CAV command eligibility
implementation.execution: Recipient's own base trajectory plus effective residual through existing centre_feasibility/build_plan bounds and allowed-speed clamp
implementation.wm_gate: Strictly positive expected base-minus-group gain and best-solo-minus-group synergy using paired finite samples and full registered release horizon
implementation.fairness: Same augmentation/screening/selection implementation and registered settings for B/R, each using its own bank
implementation.spot_checks: ceil(registered fraction * WM-kept examples); independent RNG; pending examples withheld, failed checks dropped, successful own-seed examples preserved
implementation.idempotency: Completed resolution never checks again; existing all8 machinery owns dispatch caching/charging

api.config(raw=None): Validate explicit settings; None when off
api.augment(sources, *, arm, registration=No: Pure CPU preparation; returns examples, pending spot_checks, counts, registration and receipt_sha256
api.resolve_spot_checks(batch, checker): Checker returns {confirmation, first_seed_receipt, source_confirmation_sha256}; validate complete decision/snapshot/candidate/own-seed chain before admission; return a new batch
api.spot_check_quote(request, t0): Existing conservative all8 quote including both seeds, later-harm windows and solos; caller uses source_t_s
api.verify_all8(request, *, snapshot, root,: Explicit later-run bridge; validate full bound snapshot before existing charged health/admission/verification machinery; return evidence envelope, never automatically called by augment

source_contract.confirmation: Digest-protected all8/per_seed_v1 record with arm, t0, verification_id, first_seed, seed2, candidates and per_seed_v1.examples
source_contract.example_index: Admitted cooperative example index; candidate ID/hash and own-seed tape must match verification provenance

verification.first_seed_receipt: Original authoritative digest-protected sumo_verify receipt; completed accepted/rejected status and arm-appropriate proposer
verification.snapshot_identity: Original snapshot projection for the exact sumo_verify.snapshot_sha fields: episode, policy, sumo, t0, prefixes, samples, rng, committed_plans, end_s, truncate_on_accept; metadata only, never forwarded to WM

source_contract.replication: Source seed 1 uses original snapshot; seed 2 uses replay_bank.replicate(original, original verification_id); extras use verify_perseed.extra_seed_salt. New augmentation all8 begins from that own-seed snapshot and derives its replicas using the new verification ID.

context.ego_id: Acting CAV included in source members
context.rows: Own sensing/V2V local view of CAVs and HDVs; whitelist vid, is_cav, s_m, v_mps, lane, allowed_speed_mps, observed_at_s; observed_at_s <= t_s - 1
context.policy_traj: Finite full-duration own-policy trajectory for every visible CAV only; verified source-member policy centres must match

registered_config_keys.parameter_fraction: Explicit positive fraction <= 1 of registered variety window widths
registered_config_keys.horizon_s: Explicit full run look-ahead, unchanged at scorer; >= max(duration_s, authoritative final_horizon(duration_s)) including release
registered_config_keys.bounds: Existing ordered acceleration bounds with upper cap <= 1.2 m/s^2
